one_liner: Developers can launch private apps immediately; public apps require Pipedrive approval, which adds an unknown wait time.

verdict.total_to_production: Same day for private apps, unknown for public apps.

start_today.summary: Developers can register an app in the Developer Hub using a free sandbox account, obtain credentials, and develop/test private apps without approval.
limits_before_approval: Developer sandbox accounts are limited to 5 seats by default.
Public apps require an approval process to connect other customers' accounts.
Before app approval, developers can install and test their app.
Private apps can be shared directly without approval.

composio.note: Composio does not provide a managed OAuth app for Pipedrive. Developers must register their own OAuth app in the Pipedrive Developer Hub to integrate with the toolkit.

prerequisites.detail: Required to access the Developer Hub and manage OAuth credentials.

steps.text: Create a free Pipedrive developer sandbox account.
Access the Pipedrive Developer Hub using the sandbox account.
Choose to create either a 'Public app' for the Marketplace or a 'Private app' for selected users.
Provide the App name and OAuth Callback URL (Redirect URI) in the Developer Hub.
Ensure the OAuth Callback URL is an exact match; `http://localhost` is allowed for local development.
Save the app configuration to receive Client ID and Client Secret.
Install and test your app within the sandbox environment.
Implement OAuth authorization flow, handling 60-minute access token expiry and refresh tokens.
Select necessary scopes to limit app access to user data; `base` is always enabled.
Share the private app with any Pipedrive company via a direct, unlisted installation link.
Note that private apps do not require the app approval process.
Prepare a Privacy Policy and Terms of Service webpage for public apps.
Submit the public app for listing in the Pipedrive Marketplace, triggering the approval process.
